planning_horizon.num_periods: <int> Total number of discrete time periods spanning the planning day.
planning_horizon.period_length_minutes: <int> Duration of each time period in minutes.

objective.target_utilization: <float> Target conveyor belt utilization ratio below which no penalty is incurred.
objective.threshold_values: <list[float], length num_thresholds> Ordered utilization excess thresholds above the target at which penalties are triggered.
objective.penalties: <list[int], length num_thresholds> Penalty cost associated with each utilization threshold level, increasing steeply with the threshold index.

peak_intervals.start_period: <int> First period of this peak interval during which carousel utilization is monitored.
peak_intervals.end_period: <int> Last period (inclusive) of this peak interval during which carousel utilization is monitored.

central_storage.capacity_bags: <int> Maximum number of bags that can be held in the central storage system at any time.
central_storage.depletion_rate_bags_per_period: <int> Number of bags transferred from central storage to the carousel per period during depletion.
central_storage.depletion_offset_periods: <int> Number of periods before the handling end by which storage depletion must commence.

working_rate_bags_per_period: <int> Number of bags each working station can load into containers per period.
baggage_transfer_time_periods: <int> Number of periods required to transfer baggage from storage to a carousel.
flight_end_offset_periods: <int> Number of periods before departure by which baggage handling must conclude.
quantile_used: <float> Quantile of the baggage arrival distribution used to estimate the arrival profile.
num_flights: <int> Total number of outgoing flights to be scheduled.
num_carousels: <int> Total number of carousels available for baggage handling.

carousel_config.count: <int> Number of carousels of this type.

{type_id}.Kpp: <int> Maximum number of container parking positions at a carousel of this type.
{type_id}.Kws: <int> Maximum number of working stations at a carousel of this type.
{type_id}.Kppws: <int> Number of container parking positions per working station at a carousel of this type.
{type_id}.Kcb: <int> Conveyor belt capacity (maximum bags on the belt in any period) for a carousel of this type.

carousels.type_r: <int> Type of this carousel, referencing a key in carousel_types.
carousels.Kpp: <int> Maximum number of container parking positions at this carousel.
carousels.Kws: <int> Maximum number of working stations at this carousel.
carousels.Kppws: <int> Number of container parking positions per working station at this carousel.
carousels.Kcb: <int> Conveyor belt capacity (maximum bags on the belt in any period) for this carousel.

flights.departure_period: <int> Period in which this flight departs.
flights.expected_baggage: <int> Expected total number of bags for this flight.
flights.num_containers: <int> Number of containers required to hold this flight's baggage.
flights.earliest_start_period: <int> Earliest period at which baggage handling may begin for this flight.
flights.latest_start_period: <int> Latest period at which baggage handling may begin for this flight.
flights.end_period: <int> Period by which all baggage handling must be completed for this flight.
flights.handling_duration_periods: <int> Number of periods over which baggage arrives for this flight.
flights.arrival_profile: <list[int], length handling_duration_periods> Number of bags arriving in each successive period of the handling window.

{type_id}.Wmin: <int> Minimum number of working stations required for this flight at a carousel of this type.
{type_id}.Wmax: <int> Maximum number of working stations allowed for this flight at a carousel of this type.

flights.Wmin: <int> Minimum number of working stations required for this flight across all compatible carousel types.
flights.Wmax: <int> Maximum number of working stations allowed for this flight across all compatible carousel types.
